    {
        if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open) await connection.OpenAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        
        await using var cmd = connection.CreateCommand(SqlTruncate, CommandType.Text, transaction, commandTimeout);
        
        return await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }

    public static async ValueTask<int> PatchAsync(SqlConnection connection, TestTypePatch patch, CancellationToken ct, SqlTransaction? transaction = null, int? commandTimeout = null)
    {
        if (patch.Mask == 0UL) return 0;
        if (connection.State != ConnectionState.Open) await connection.OpenAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);

        await using var cmd = new SqlCommand("", connection, transaction);
        if (commandTimeout.HasValue) cmd.CommandTimeout = commandTimeout.Value;

        var sb = new StringBuilder("UPDATE [dbo].[TestTypes] SET ");
        var separator = "";

        if ((patch.Mask & (1UL << 5)) != 0) { sb.Append(separator + "[StringVarcharRuledNull] = @StringVarcharRuledNull"); separator = ", "; cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeSql.CreateParameterStringVarcharRuledNull((string)patch.StringVarcharRuledNullValue!)); }
        if ((patch.Mask & (1UL << 6)) != 0) { sb.Append(separator + "[CharString] = @CharString"); separator = ", "; cmd.Parameters.Add(TestTypeSql.CreateParameterCharString((string)patch.CharStringValue!)); }

/// <summary>Extension methods for patching <see cref="TestType"/> via <see cref="SqlConnection"/>.</summary>
public static class TestTypeSqlPatchExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Executes a partial UPDATE for <see cref="TestType"/>, touching only the columns
    /// explicitly set on <paramref name="patch"/>.
    /// Returns 0 immediately (without sending SQL) when no columns were set.
    /// </summary>
    public static global::System.Threading.Tasks.ValueTask<int> PatchAsync(
        this SqlConnection connection,
        TestTypePatch patch,
        global::System.Threading.CancellationToken ct,
        SqlTransaction? transaction = null,
        int? commandTimeout = null)
        => TestType.PatchAsync(connection, patch, ct, transaction, commandTimeout);
}
